verification.scope: Source-checkout catalog, disclosure, relationship-profile and impact checks over independent fixtures. Installed qualification and native application acceptance are separate.
verification.statusMeaning: Verified means that the test exercised the behavior and observed the expected decision and diagnostic. An expected failed or incomplete decision is a verified negative case.
verification.standards: RDFLib parses exported DCAT graphs. The pinned OpenLineage schemas validate exported events and version facets. A local independent receiver checks OpenLineage identity and replay.

Loads the nested product and checks an ordered list self-relation with literal dotted field names against independently expected matches.
Rejects resolving a virtual row position from a pair of versions without a common exact release.
Removes the date from both sides of a dated composite key and checks that the missing component fails validation.
Retains the older passing observation and checks that it cannot qualify the current output under a different rule revision.
Preserves a successful run and its discoverable output while a required absent check remains not_run.
Runs two fresh processes, guards payload opens and copies and subprocess execution, verifies equal output bytes, and preserves executed check assurance.

Validates events and version facets against the pinned schemas, replays authored native-format and generated records through an independent local SQLite receiver, and resolves dataset keys back to exact native references.
Changes the terminal outcome to unknown, preserves the JobEvent and observed START, and verifies there is no terminal event.
Compares exact snapshots and verifies affected recipe obligations, metadata regeneration, and requalification while computation remains unaffected by the changed rule.
Requests complete consumer scope and verifies the outside project remains listed and the decision incomplete.
Builds from declarations alone, retains meanings and recipes, and checks that availability, execution, and current selection are unresolved.
Moves the output set, removes the original project copy, verifies companion SQL bytes and exact input bindings, and rejects a wrong version or altered SQL before invoking the reader.
Separates public from preview and verifies two disjoint current datasets through RDFLib. Rebuilds without a selector and checks there are no current links.
Changes the selection record order and observation time and verifies that the overlapping scope fails in both orders without replacing output.
Keeps the partial input scope and emits only observed consumption when a separate source and dataset version are also retained.
Evaluates independently authored composite matches with different dates, different binary values, padded text, and every supported null policy.
Requires a versioned project rule and verifies its unavailable evaluator leaves the comparison unknown while retaining the declaration.
Assemble once, count one read of each recipe SQL source, retain its exact bytes and all requested standard outputs, and verify that the atomic writer uses those retained bytes.
A required check is unknown. Return admitted definitions and companions with their unchanged check status, no publishable controls, and the previous complete output intact.
A contextual relationship does not resolve. Refuse structural admission and return neither catalog nor companion bytes.
Retain a recipe title, ordered notes, explicit positional parameter order, and resolved contextual relationships. Preserve actual query inputs without adding contextual endpoints.

Disclose selected nested and list field paths with necessary ancestors, types and nullability. Withhold unlisted siblings, native properties and the original private root object name; retain explicit partial-path scope.

Retain root and imported project extensions separately with exact declaring identities and namespace. Public extension access requires the exact source revision and explicit extension namespace grant.

The same virtual field supports a row-position identity and an additional unique key with identical path, type and scope. Resolve it once without inventing a physical ODCS property or losing the original key.
Two virtual declarations of one path disagree about type or scope. Refuse the relationship and catalog admission.

Load an external target without treating it as a local alias or fetching it. Retain the relationship, local import scope and unknown shared comparison; a required comparison keeps the build incomplete.

Changing recipe documentation or contextual endpoint meaning requires metadata and reader review. Actual input and production changes retain their stronger computation obligations; rule changes require qualification separately.
Change one scoped opaque project extension. Record the metadata change and unresolved domain impact without inventing a computation dependency.
An explicitly supplied profile establishes declaration support for fixed-width native byte keys while preserving ordered composite components and leaving observed matches and qualification absent.
A fixture-owned profile interprets exact versioned text-to-integer and list-overlap declarations from resolved ordered key definitions. DDK supplies no application rule names or data observations.
Support external digest-and-suffix reference construction while retaining the external namespace, not_assessed existence, and no version, run or qualification evidence.
Unsupported exact rule versions, rule identities, native types and external meanings remain required unknown outcomes with an admitted catalog but no complete output set.
A release-local virtual key used outside its release scope fails before the application profile can override the shared guard.
Untyped, malformed, unsupported-status or empty-reason profile results remain required unknown results and cannot generate a complete output set.
Capture the explicit profile source once per assembly, preserve its original digest and tool identity in catalog and lock, and accept an exact distribution pin without discovering source.
Refuse a public catalog whose selected profile ID is a private file URI without an explicit identifier grant; retain a safe public report, local provenance and the previous complete output.
An empty disclosure-only field path grants root descriptions only when descriptions are enabled, without exposing children, native properties or custom metadata.

Changed profile provenance or declaration assessments require metadata and reader checks only along actually assessed relationships. Preserve unresolved domain effects, unused profiles and relationships outside the snapshot without claiming computation reuse.
Reject incoherent profile provenance, mismatched assessment identities, unsupported assessment status or invented external existence during impact comparison.

Compare two actual generated public catalogs after a selected profile revision or source change. Retain permitted identity and redacted source, withhold private assessments and reasons, and preserve unknown assessment/consumer scope without fabricated reader dependencies.

Explicit physical-type grants with complete modeled-subtree disclosure preserve the exact native string, including native-only names. Declared objects and arrays remain composite without modeled children; nested permissions preserve only their admitted type values.

Complete logical field disclosure without explicit opaque-type permission still withholds composite native text. Root metadata grants reveal no root native type, while existing scalar disclosure remains exact.

A missing or hidden dataset, absent or blank type, invalid or root path, or incomplete modeled-subtree permission refuses public disclosure. A partial field grant plus a composite type grant preserves the previous complete output set.

Return private full metadata and the public view from the same captured source and one metadata read. Later source changes or private result mutations cannot change public metadata or make it disagree with the retained artifact bytes.

An unresolved required qualification keeps admitted private metadata available while public artifacts remain unavailable and the report incomplete. A separate structural failure leaves both catalogs absent.

Map exact retained native metadata into an actual catalog with complete scoped membership, original request bytes, captured definitions and deterministic controls. Open no payload or caller JobSpec; preserve private members in their native record and unknown row-consumption coverage. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Refuse changed candidates, incomplete native output/report membership, altered original bytes, caller pass booleans and resealed acceptance with wrong checks, evaluator, semantics or retained input pins. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Require every native input and output to have exactly one catalog mapping or explicit out-of-catalog reason; refuse omitted, overlapping or unknown members. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Retain completed native computation when accepted qualification is absent. Keep required quality unknown, expose no publishable artifacts and preserve previously written controls. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

An admitted pending job can retain known sealed outputs without claiming a completed or qualified candidate. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Retain known outputs and unresolved qualification when native execution is unknown or failed; preserve the native failed outcome separately from missing quality evidence. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Changed authored constraints, production identity or original definition custody cannot inherit old native acceptance, even if effective schema bytes remain equal. Do not attach the old run to the current production. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Known output field, type or membership mismatches fail schema interpretation even when the separate native policy passed. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Preserve supported nested field positions, dictionary strings, exact fixed binary width and explicit timestamp semantics in output-schema interpretation. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Unsupported authored meanings and unmatched value constraints remain unknown. Nullable nested observations preserve compatible schema facts while leaving required row properties unresolved. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Use an explicitly supplied generator and original JobSpec to bind authored required, ordered key uniqueness and key nonnull facets to exact accepted report counters. Preserve nullable schema observations and open no payload or caller JobSpec. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Wrong writer, SQL, field, counter, original job, source or profile and missing, duplicate or unauthored bindings cannot qualify authored facets. Callback inputs remain immutable. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Retain authored primary-key obligations independently of an alternate catalog key. Missing or duplicate primary positions remain unresolved rather than disappearing behind the alternate key. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Public native facet claims retain the explicitly granted generator identity separately from the native evaluator. Source locations require an evidence grant; private native members and diagnostics remain withheld. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

A public native facet claim without an explicit generator identifier grant refuses disclosure and produces safe public diagnostics. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

An exact supported native export can establish uniqueness only for the entire visible ordered key. Same-output schema and accepted required-field facts separately establish every component of a nonnull key. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

A hidden additional sort field, mismatched runtime or settings, or missing nonnull evidence prevents full key qualification. Unique larger tuples never prove a visible key subset unique; uniqueness alone never proves nonnull. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

A declared row_position supplies its complete same-release key even when physical keys also exist, without a duplicate virtual key declaration or fabricated executed uniqueness evidence. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

A row_position identity cannot authorize a version-pair relationship outside its same-release scope. Source tests use independently constructed metadata; installed qualification and actual native execution remain separate.

Nested authored primary keys inside objects and list elements remain required unknown until their scoped native interpretation is supported; nullable schema metadata and an unrelated accepted policy cannot erase them. Independent metadata fixtures establish translation only; native execution qualification remains separate.

The original native policy ID cannot acquire different original policy bytes or accepted authority conditions, even when metadata witnesses are coherently resealed. Independently authored metadata and actual assembler checks; native execution has separate evidence.

A distinct native requalification policy ID may retain the original prepare request while binding a new policy and authority pair. Do not require original and requalified policies to be equal. Independently authored metadata and actual assembler checks; native execution has separate evidence.

Version 2 native-table metadata preserves the original selector, exact requested metadata pin, original member locations and native owner without opening payloads. This is an offline consistency check, not proof of native execution or protection. Source verifier tests use independently authored metadata; installed qualification and actual native custody remain separate.

Coherently resealed version 2 metadata refuses mixed witness versions, missing or conflicting snapshot pins, overlapping file bindings and an unsupported passed-boolean prerequisite. Source verifier tests use independently authored metadata; installed qualification and actual native custody remain separate.

The complete candidate and its view set must both contain the same typed snapshot custody. Missing copies, boolean integers and integral decimal tokens cannot replace native integer selectors or sizes. Source verifier tests use independently authored metadata; installed qualification and actual native custody remain separate.

Coherently resealed custody metadata refuses invalid roles, order, duplicate locations, foreign ownership, sizes, digests, original-operation identity and contradictory empty or selected-snapshot membership. Native seals remain responsible for actual closure completeness. Source verifier tests use independently authored metadata; installed qualification and actual native custody remain separate.

An explicitly empty selected snapshot retains only its original metadata. Preserve an earlier origin_operation identity in authored metadata without claiming native cross-operation reuse was executed. Source verifier tests use independently authored metadata; installed qualification and actual native custody remain separate.
